## Chamber / json-chamber (security product)
- φ-split keyword shares + AES-256-GCM
- 24-hour evaluation from first run (hard cut, no grace)
- Tamper-evident HMAC-signed license under ~/.chamber/
- After expiry or license edit the chamber hard-kills
- One-time $99 unlock removes the kill-switch forever
- Pure security — no TRU8 compression engine inside
- BSL-1.1 open source (Change Date 2030-08-13 → Apache-2.0)
- Page: https://www.slidphilabs.com/chamber
- SDK: https://github.com/ceedot-rock/json-chamber-sdk
- Format (wire only): https://github.com/ceedot-rock/json-chamber-sdk/blob/main/CHAMBER-FORMAT-v1.md

## Pricing tiers
| SKU | What | Price |

| tru8-chamber | TRU8 + chamber (smaller bundles + cloaking) | $1,900 / project / year |

## Chamber Format v1 (interoperability)
- Sealed JSON object: v, algo, k_words, r_words, nonce, tag, ct
- algo = chamber-aes256gcm-phi · AAD = chamber-v1
- 2-of-2 φ-split · 64-word keyword encoding
- License / trial / unlock are out of scope of the format
- Suggested media type (informative): application/chamber+json

## Chamber trial model
- 24 hours fully functional from first run on the machine
- After 24h (or license tamper) the box permanently shuts off
- One-time $99 Stripe payment removes the kill-switch forever

## TRU8 (compression — separate product)
- Public demos free with credit
- T_ZERO / T_DICT / T_TRISUM_HOT public tokens
- Suite (metered): free first 100 GB · then ~5¢/GB · /pps
- Studio bundling with chamber = tru8-chamber tier (proprietary)
